pokedexEntries.ru: TAILLOW courageously stands its ground against foes, however strong they may be. This gutsy POKéMON will remain defiant even after a loss. On the other hand, it cries loudly if it becomes hungry.

pokedexEntries.sa: TAILLOW is young - it has only just left its nest. As a result, it sometimes becomes lonesome and cries at night. This POKéMON feeds on WURMPLE that live in forests.

pokedexEntries.frlg: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles a day.

pokedexEntries.em: Although it is small, it is very courageous. It will take on a larger SKARMORY on an equal footing. However, its will weakens if it becomes hungry.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

pokedexEntries.hgss: When it gets cold, they migrate, flying over 180 miles a day. It hunts for tasty prey.
